lede: Build-time content from Netlify Blobs, cached locally with a TTL you control, so builds stay fast, survive an outage, & never fail on missing data.

usage.caption: eleventy.config.js

features.title: Cached by default
features.body: Reads hit a local cache first & reach Netlify Blobs only once an entry passes its TTL: fewer calls & faster builds, everywhere.

features.title: Never fails a build
features.body: If the store is unreachable, the last good copy is served & flagged stale. Past that, an error envelope arrives instead of an exception.

features.title: Builds offline
features.body: After one warm build, every build inside the TTL runs with no credentials & no network, locally & in CI alike.

features.title: One dependency
features.body: Nothing but @netlify/blobs: no build step, no runtime, pure ESM.
